note: Initial floor for cyclomatic complexity in the core package. Scope: 'ruff check odoo/ --no-cache --select C901' (the core package only, same scope as the ruff floor), threshold [lint.mccabe] max-complexity = 20 in ruff.toml. Measured 46 with ruff 0.16.2, the requirements-dev.txt pin. This gate existed on paper and did nothing: ruff.toml selected the C90 family, ignored C901 -- its ONLY rule -- and set max-complexity, three settings that cancel out. The two branch-complexity rules also justified their suppression by pointing at each other (C901: 'see PLR0912'; PLR0912: 'redundant with C90'), while both were off. Costs nothing today, since the floor is the current count. Kept out of the ruff aggregate on purpose: in one bucket a complexity fix can be masked by an unrelated new finding, and the floor exists so a cleanup locks in. For scale: the core's longest function is tools/config.py::_build_cli at 1023 lines (123 add_option calls, 11 groups) against a mean function length of 14 and p95 of 56, so the tail is a handful of outliers rather than a house style. Raising max-complexity lowers this count without fixing anything -- move the threshold only with the same deliberation as the count, and record it here. Command: ruff check odoo/ --no-cache --select C901 --statistics | awk '{s+=$1} END {print s+0}'
